## Usage recommendations

- Apply 3–4 times per week with 5–10 minute scalp massage (champi)
- Leave oil for at least 2 hours before washing with sulphate-free shampoo
- Reduced hair fall typically in 2–4 weeks; visible growth in 6–8 weeks with consistent use
